content: Fixed. The bug was in Cache.Get in pkg/x/cache.go: it only treated an entry as expired once now was more than 1ns past expiresAt, so a Get at exactly the TTL still returned the value. I changed the check to !now.Before(expiresAt). TestCacheExpiry now passes, and go vet and go test -race ./... are clean.
